doctrine: Coverage-extension of the signed measurement spine to in-orbit AI. The core fact: every in-orbit AI result is self-reported — no independent body measures on-board AI behaviour, no space software-assurance standard covers AI (ECSS/NASA/DO-178C handle deterministic SW only), jurisdiction undefined. We record what was publicly claimed + what is independently verifiable, with deterministic predicates. Never novel accusations. Measurement, not certification. Receipt format is RFC 9943 (SCITT)-aligned: COSE-style signed statement on an append-only log, offline-verifiable against a published key.
note: deployed vs announced separated throughout. Economics contested (Altman: 'ridiculous'; Gartner: 'bubble'; thermal: 1 rack = 80 m2 radiator).
